thread:
Maya (Design): quick check-in on the batch vectors inspector and CSV export microflow. trying to lock down: default collapsed rows for large sets, export columns, and keyboard + screen reader behavior. latest mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
Omar (Product): customers running rerank pipelines want an opt-in source column, and a tiny preview in the inspector. can we keep inspector super compact by default? :+1:
Priya (Eng): compact default is doable. prefer virtualization for large lists (>500). collapsed rows should still expose a small action bar (copy id, open detail). avoid rendering full vector previews until expanded.
Ravi (A11y): a11y notes: 1) row toggle must have aria-controls and aria-expanded. 2) when expanding, focus should move into the panel. 3) announce "X results loaded" on data load. Use polite aria-live.
Sara (QA): CSV copy mismatch: modal header uses "Export vectors" but the CTA says "Export CSV". pick one. Also test CSV with localized decimals (comma vs dot) in target locales.
Tomas (Support): ask: include a small example CSV header in modal (collapsed by default) so users see columns. Many support tickets are "where's my source text column?"
Maya (Design): proposed modal layout:
- H2: "Export vectors"
- helper: "Contains vector ids, scores, and embeddings. Toggle to include original source text."
- checkbox: "Include original source text (opt-in)"
- primary: "Export CSV"
- collapsed example block: shows headers and first row (truncated embeddings)
Is this too wordy?
Omar (Product): add limit copy: "Up to 10k vectors. Larger exports run in background and you'll get a link." Important for expectations.
Priya (Eng): server notes: streaming flattened floats is huge. options:
- CSV with floats (huge)
- JSONL gz (better compression)
- base64 embedding column (decodes to floats)
We should default to CSV for <1k, JSONL.gz for >1k (or user chooses).
Ravi (A11y): background export must post an accessible notification. When export job completes, send a system notification with role=alert and link that keyboard users can open. Job list should be navigable.
Sara (QA): test plan items: keyboard navigation for expand/collapse; screen reader announcement for export start/completion; CSV parse test in Excel/Sheets; background job cancel flows.
Tomas (Support): small copy request: change helper to "Includes vector ids and scores. Source text is opt-in and included only in the downloaded file." helps with privacy concerns.
Maya (Design): updated copy suggestion:
- Modal title: "Export vectors"
- Primary: "Export CSV"
- Helper: "Includes vector ids and scores. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."
- Checkbox: "Include original source text"
- Example toggle: "Show example headers"
Other: keep example collapsed by default.
i18n-bot: note: avoid concatenated strings, provide placeholders for numbers (e.g., "%d vectors") and separate pieces for button text and helper text.
Omar (Product): action items: Priya to prototype server export policy and estimate dev effort. Ravi to draft a11y acceptance criteria. Maya to update mocks and add code example. Sara to write QA checklist. Tomas to draft support blurb.
Priya (Eng): rough estimate: inspector virtualization ~4 dev days. export flow + background jobs + notifications ~6 dev days. storage+ops changes TBD.
Ravi (A11y): I'll post a short checklist here by EOD covering aria attributes, live regions, focus management, and job notifications.
Maya (Design): thanks everyone 680 will update Figma and drop the example snippet. Ping me if anything blocks.
